mentions.title: King main bearings setting up loose?
mentions.snippet: Builder reports a 2024 King main bearing measuring out of spec on free spread, and says a 2025 main bearing appears to have the same issue, suggesting a manufacturing process problem rather than a one-off. Next production run cited as January 2027.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Poster reports King STDX thrust bearings measured over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85 and S65 blocks, and concludes King main bearings should not be used for those engines. Explicit buyer warning framing.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on a diesel truck forum about King main thrust bearings. Title itself is an explicit warning to other builders.
mentions.replyNote: Readable today for the first time after months of 403s: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, last post dated 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received an unopened King package with mismatched shell sizes and says King declined to supply a replacement half shell, directing him back to the supplier. Complaint is about service response as much as the part.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is---King Bearings are no longer an option....
mentions.snippet: Thread arguing King bearings are no longer a viable choice for 6-bolt builds, citing repeatedly extended back-order dates. Availability complaint with a dismissive stance on the brand.
